title: Build a Grounded Robot Perception Pipeline
summary: Fuse supplied phrase-mask predictions into a calibrated occupancy map and evaluate a synthetic perception release.

runtime.budget_status: actual shared worker caps; per-process address-space limit

frames: Declared optical camera/world frames or explicitly nonspatial feature axes

units.values: Meters, pixels, milliseconds, normalized features and rates as defined in the contract

physical_contract.axes: Explicitly defined below; feature axes do not imply physical directions.
physical_contract.timestamp_assumptions: Inputs describe one synchronized observation unless the contract explicitly defines history. No clock estimation.
physical_contract.batching: Only dimensions explicitly named in the function contract are supported.

fixtures.source: original synthetic examples in examples.md; future generated fixtures use declared seed

provenance.authoring_notes: Original cross-paper synthetic integration. Its stage contracts, limits, diagnostics and release policies are teaching choices, not a reproduced trained model or permission to deploy hardware.
